recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. FHIR-5760 is satisfied through FHIR-7760 and later current-model refinements; renaming the operation input back to a literal dependsOn form would be a separate breaking change and is not warranted by this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-5760 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 vocab change request for ConceptMap/$translate. It asked for dependsOn information to be accepted by the operation so translations could be specialized by another data value, such as a unit dependency in the Device Clinical Bridge example. The final Jira resolution says it was resolved as part of task 7760.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-5760. Jira comments point to FHIR-7760, whose snapshot records svn revision 5518 as the application. The corresponding git-svn commit b1e826a4b8 added translate.dependency 0..* as an input tuple with element/concept parts and translate.match.product 0..* as an output tuple in the historical ConceptMap spreadsheet. The combined branch already contains a no-change audit commit for FHIR-7760 confirming that application trail.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini and source/conceptmap/list-ConceptMap-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ConceptMap-translate, so the checked operation definition is current build-scope source. Later ConceptMap decisions and reconciliations intentionally refined the old tuple model: the operation parameter is dependency rather than literal dependsOn, parts are now attribute/value, and match.product and match.dependsOn values align with the current ConceptMap dependsOn/product type surface.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current operation definition already has dependency 0..* as an input parameter with attribute/value parts, match.product 0..* and match.dependsOn 0..* output parts with the same value surface, and ConceptMap notes tell clients to provide dependsOn.attribute values when translating.
